title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Late-Payment Charge Line
content:
An unpaid balance on a completed call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls accrues late-payment charges once the late-payment grace has passed. Each charge is posted as a late-payment charge line on the call's invoice and raises the balance owing on that call.

## Conditions on figuring the charge

> No late-payment charge is figured until the invoice of a call whose technician arrived after the end of the booked window and the arrival grace carries the late-arrival credit owed on it.

> The late-payment charge is fixed only after every refrigerant line on an active member's call carries the member refrigerant allowance line owed on it.

## Posting tool: `post_late_payment_charge_b790dc9b`

**What it does.** The tool posts a late-payment charge on the invoice of one completed service call and raises the amount the customer owes on that call by the charge. Each call of the tool adds one `late_payment_charge` line to the call's invoice, dated today, and increases the call's invoice balance by exactly the amount given. Nothing else on the call changes. The tool does not check eligibility or amounts; it books what it is given.

**How it is invoked.** This is a hidden agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it by the name `post_late_payment_charge_b790dc9b`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the service call whose invoice is charged | Id, read from the service call lookup |
| `amount` | The late-payment charge being billed | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; a value with more decimals is rounded to the cent half up when booked |

**Return.** The tool returns a receipt with `line_id` (reference number of the new invoice line), `ticket_id` (the call charged), `line_type` (always `late_payment_charge`), `amount` (the USD amount booked, to 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date) and `ticket_balance` (the call's invoice balance in USD after the charge). A receipt carrying a `line_id` means the charge is on the invoice. The new line is visible at once in the call's invoice lines, and the new balance on the call itself.
